about: The real runs behind the presets' timings, one per preset or measured setting, each on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080. The gallery pictures were drawn again from GM1 0.1.0 runs of the same presets at the same sizes on an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090; each preset's picture.json names that run.

grid.words: 1 km grid · 120 × 120 km · 2 h of storm time

receipts.fit_summary: A 120 × 120 km area at 1 km, 2 h of storm time. About 79 s on your RTX 3080 (estimated). Needs 1.1 GB of GPU memory and about 4.0 GB of disk.
receipts.gpu_memory_basis: nvidia-smi memory.used sampled every 0.5 s during the run, less the value just before it (WSL2 lists no per-process memory)

storm.rule: a storm formed when the strongest updraft reached 10 m/s and rain water 1 g/kg at some saved time

receipts.command: gpuwm-cm1 preset new your-environment --budget 10m --root ~/gm1-runs --name your-environment-i0.5-s0.5 --instability 0.5 --shear 0.5 --hodograph curved

grid.words: 1 km grid · 96 × 96 km · 2 h of storm time

receipts.fit_summary: A 96 × 96 km area at 1 km, 2 h of storm time. About 2.5 min on your RTX 3080 (estimated). Needs 1.2 GB of GPU memory and about 2.1 GB of disk.
fit_sentences: Used 1 km grid spacing instead of 250 m (and a 3 s time step instead of 1.5 s, no longer than CM1's own 6 s per 500 m of level height with these 250 m levels) so it fits in your GPU's 1.4 GB of free memory and finishes in about 10 minutes; its full 250 m version needs about 9.7 GB of free GPU memory.
Made the area 96 km wide instead of 120 km so it fits in your GPU's 1.4 GB of free memory.
